t: The LAP Molly outdoor PIR motion sensor is designed to automatically control external lighting. This mains-powered unit is ideal for domestic electricians and DIYers looking to secure driveways, gardens, entrances and pathways. Featuring a wide 180° detection angle and a 12m range, the sensor triggers connected lights instantly upon detecting movement. The durable white plastic body carries an IP44 rating, ensuring reliable operation in weather conditions. Users can easily customise the setup using the adjustable dusk-to-dawn sensor and variable time-on controls to suit specific property layouts.
b: Secures Driveways, Gardens, Entrances & Pathways Effectively
Easy Wall-Mounted Installation for Quick Setup
Adjusts Dusk-to-Dawn Sensitivity and Time-On Settings Easily
